response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced full-stack and systems developer with strong background in Node.js, TypeScript, DLang, and web platforms, but has only minimal, dated C++ exposure (a ~6-month stint in 2014-2015 writing components for an IDE and a university thesis project), no evident Windows-platform development, no SQL Server/Oracle experience, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure at any point in the career history.
strengths: 15+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong seniority and leadership (Staff/Senior titles)
Demonstrated ability to work across many languages and platforms (JS/TS, DLang, Java, C#, Swift)
Strong communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source project leadership
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (~6 months, over 10 years ago) and far short of the required 5-10 years
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience anywhere in work history
No SQL Server or Oracle experience noted; only generic SQL/MySQL/MongoDB listed, and no Windows-platform development evident

key_factors.factor: No capital markets/fixed income/investment banking domain experience
No SQL Server/Oracle or Windows platform evidence
